segments.text: NOt every deadly Sin willingly committed after Baptiſm, is Sin againſt the Holy Ghoſt, and unpardonable: Wherefore the Grant of Repentance is not to be denied to ſuch as fall into ſin after Baptiſm. After we have received the Holy Ghoſt, we may depart from Grace given, and fall into ſin, and by the Grace of God, we may ariſe again, & amend our Lives. And therefore they are to be condemned, which ſay they can no more ſin as long as they live here, to deny the place of Forgiveneſs to ſuch as truly repent.
